title: Look beyond the finished garment.
summary: Every fabric is a chain of decisions.
cover_alt: An indigo textile study accompanying a field note
body:
A garment is the visible end of a much longer process. Fibre choice, yarn structure, fabric construction, dyeing, finishing, and assembly all influence its properties.

A comfortable shirt is not explained by a single specification. Its feel and performance come from decisions made across the production chain.

Following those connections is part of learning textile engineering: look at the finished product, then work backwards through the choices that made it possible.
label: FIELD NOTE · TEXTILES
